subject: general
question: In March 2025, which three Central Asian countries signed the Khujand Treaty to settle border disputes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khujand Treaty** was officially signed in **March 2025** by the nations of **Tajikistan**, **Kyrgyzstan**, and **Uzbekistan** to settle long-standing territorial and border delimitation disputes.
 
• The treaty takes its name from **Khujand**, the second-largest city in **Tajikistan** and a major administrative center in the **Fergana Valley**, which served as the venue for the high-level diplomatic summit.
 
• The primary objective of the agreement is to finalize the demarcation of nearly **1,000 kilometers** of contested borders that have been a source of recurring conflict since the **dissolution of the Soviet Union** in **1991**.
 
• The signing involved the respective **Heads of State**, emphasizing a shift toward **Central Asian solidarity** and regional economic cooperation rather than military confrontation.
 
• The **Khujand Treaty** specifically addresses the management of **enclaves and exclaves**, ensuring that residents in these isolated territories have guaranteed transit rights and access to essential resources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Fergana Valley:** 
 
 
• This region is shared by **Uzbekistan**, **Kyrgyzstan**, and **Tajikistan** and is the most densely populated area in **Central Asia**.
 
• Due to its **fertile soil** and strategic location, it has been the epicenter of ethnic tensions and border skirmishes over **land rights** and **irrigation water**.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:** 
 
 
• The borders in this region were originally drawn during the **Stalinist era** of the **Soviet Union** without regard for ethnic distributions, leading to the creation of complex enclaves such as **Vorukh** (Tajik enclave in Kyrgyzstan) and **Sokh** (Uzbek enclave in Kyrgyzstan).
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Agreement:** 
 
 
• Settling these disputes is a prerequisite for major infrastructure projects, including the **China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan (CKU) railway**, which aims to enhance trade routes between **East Asia** and **Europe**.
 
• The **2025** treaty builds upon the momentum of the **2023** bilateral agreement between **Bishkek** and **Tashkent**, which successfully resolved their mutual border issues.
 
 
 
• **Regional Impact:** 
 
 
• By resolving these issues, the three countries aim to reduce the influence of external security actors and strengthen the role of the **Consultative Meetings of Central Asian Heads of State** as a primary forum for conflict resolution.
 
• It also minimizes the risk of **water-sharing conflicts**, which are expected to intensify in the **Amu Darya** and **Syr Darya** basins due to climate change.
